Hi Elena

Great questions, answers below inline:

1) Rate limits:
- Default: 60 requests/min per API key (token-generation endpoints vary by model and seq length).
- Burst: we support short bursts; the Hosted control plane allows soft-bursting up to ~3x for <60s depending on region and current capacity.
- If you expect sustained higher QPS we recommend Dedicated (reserved capacity) which provides predictable throughput. I attached a CSV with our common rate tiers for reference.

2) Endpoints & multi-tenant isolation:
- Hosted API is multi-tenant but logically isolated per API key; we do not share customer inputs/outputs across accounts.
- Data residency: Hosted is currently available in us-west and eu-west regions; we can route your traffic to us-west for now. For strict residency or on-prem needs, Private VPC is available as a later step.

3) Path to Dedicated:
- Timeline: onboarding Dedicated typically takes 2-4 weeks after contract (depending on sizing and scheduling).
- Minimums: monthly committed GPUs or throughput commitments we can size this after the eval once you share expected steady-state QPS and latency SLOs.

Security questionnaire: please send the Finlytics questionnaire to security@redwood.ai and I'll loop in our security lead.

Proposed tech session times: Thu Jul 22 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri Jul 23 09:00-10:00 PT. Which works best?

Quickstart + sample curl (helpful to copy/paste):
- Quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart-hosted-api
- curl example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TEMP_KEY>' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","prompt":"Summarize the sales notes"}'

I attached the rate/quotas CSV. Happy to provision a trial API key for 14 days once procurement gives the OK.
